business_problem: With global giants like Google, Amazon, and Netflix setting new standards for personalized content delivery, Class Editori recognized that consumer habits were shifting toward conversational interfaces.
solution_summary: Class Editori partnered with Softlab to build a scalable data platform on Google Cloud and MFGPT, one of Italy's first generative AI financial news agents. By using BigQuery, Firestore, and Vertex AI, the company unified decades of content to deliver personalized, revenue-generating experiences for subscribers and enterprise clients. The flagship achievement of this partnership is MFGPT, one of Italy’s first generative AI agents in the media landscape. Built using Gemini Flash and Pro models, MFGPT provides subscribers with a conversational interface to query articles, podcasts, videos, and real-time financial data. The platform uses BigQuery as its central data warehouse for structured data, while Dataflow manages complex pipelines. For its AI capabilities, Class Editori chose Vertex AI, citing its completeness for both standard machine learning and generative AI.
